references.author: University of Madras
references.publisher: University of Madras; digitized headword hosted by Agarathi
references.note: Headword defines vilaṅku as beast or bird, with a general animal sense. The online page reproduces the University of Madras Tamil Lexicon entry.

references.title: கயிறு (kayiṟu), University of Madras Tamil Lexicon headword
references.author: University of Madras
references.publisher: University of Madras; digitized headword hosted by Agarathi
references.note: Headword defines kayiṟu as rope, cord, string, twine and cable. The online page reproduces the University of Madras Tamil Lexicon entry.

references.title: கரடி (karaṭi), University of Madras Tamil Lexicon headword
references.author: University of Madras
